steps.text: Slice each chicken breast half horizontally into two thin cutlets, then pat them dry and season with the salt and pepper.
Spread the flour on a plate. Press each cutlet into it on both sides and shake off the excess - a thin, even coat is all the sauce needs.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until it shimmers. Lay in the cutlets without crowding and sear undisturbed for 4 minutes, until deep brown on the first side.
Flip and cook 3 minutes more. Chicken is safe at 165°F (74°C) - check the thickest cutlet with a thermometer before pulling it.

safety.source: USDA FSIS safe minimum internal temperature table

steps.text: Move the cutlets to a warm plate and pour off all but a thin film of fat from the pan.
Add the butter and let it foam for about 30 seconds, scraping the browned bits loose with a spatula - they are the sauce's backbone.
Pour in the lemon juice and add the capers; simmer for 1 minute until the sauce thickens slightly.
Return the cutlets and any resting juices to the pan and spoon the sauce over them for 30 seconds so they glaze.
Shower with the parsley and serve. Taste the sauce first: it should be bright and a little briny, with more lemon if it isn't.

nutrition_per_serving.basis: USDA FoodData Central values committed in apps/ios/Resources/usda_ingredient_catalog.sqlite (matched fdc_id per ingredient in tables/nutrition-map.json), plus the app's shipped core-ingredient table (data.json) for items without an fdc_id; scaled by evidenced gram quantities
